items.prompt: What must be true before you use a heap-head merge for timestamped logs?
items.modelAnswer: Each stream must be ordered by the same usable key; source identity, equal-key sequence and information availability must be declared. State empty/error/stale behavior and memory/output boundaries.

criteria.text: Names per-stream ordering and shared key.
Separates a merge algorithm from a production ingestion policy.
